text:
maya: Heads-up — preflight for tonight's 03:00 UTC change window. This touches API/runtime/console/router. Need final pins, rollback criteria, and clear owners for the cutover. Deploybot scheduled at 03:05. @sam @leo @anya @ops-oncall

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy queued: change-id=2026-03-23-rc3. Preflight checklist: health checks, db migration, header-split, canary 5%. To proceed, react with :white_check_mark:. Will auto-run preflight in 5m unless aborted.

sam: runtime note — kernel v2.1.8 required for KV eviction fix (prevents stuck KV entries under high QPS). Staging currently on 2.1.7. Upgrade adds ~3% mem but avoids the eviction regression. If we can't bump, fallback path is compatible but expect slightly higher GC churn.

leo: console migration: running `migrations/2026/03/add_route_index.sql`. Plan is to put console read-only for ~2m during the migration. Console pin requested: console-1.12.3. UI feature flag for route-search will be off for the canary.

anya: router: header-split rollout planned — route-table update + header rewrite. I'll pin router to rtr-2026-03-23-1 for the window. Need a 10m validation window post-canary to confirm header rewrite doesn't surface 4xx from downstreams. No breaking API contract changes expected.

ops-oncall: Ops thresholds: if 95th latency > 120ms OR error rate > 0.5% in canary, abort and rollback. Also require standby capacity +20% during canary and warmup scripts complete. Pager rule `deploy-window` will be active.

maya: Rollback plan summarised: immediate rollback to pinned versions if triggers hit. Pins (pre-deploy): API=api-7.8.2, runtime=rt-2.1.8, console=console-1.12.3, router=rtr-2026-03-23-1. Rollback targets (previous): API=api-7.8.1, runtime=rt-2.1.7, console=console-1.12.2, router=rtr-2026-03-22. Trigger conditions: latency/error thresholds OR auth failures OR DB migration errors. Canary cadence: 5% for 10m -> 25% for 15m -> full.

sam: Preflight KV warmup command I'll run in 10m: ```scripts/warm_kv.sh --region=us-east-1 --parallel=3``` This will populate caches to avoid cold-thrashing when canary traffic hits.

deploy-bot: Deploy command queued: `deploy --change 2026-03-23-rc3 --canary 5 --owners maya,sam,leo,anya --pin api-7.8.2,rt-2.1.8,console-1.12.3,router-rtr-2026-03-23-1`

anya: I'll tail header error logs during canary: path `/logs/router/header-errors` — will post failures here if any spike.

leo: Console migration steps (short): 1) set read-only, 2) run sql, 3) verify index usage, 4) unset read-only. Command I'll run: `pg_ctl -m fast` to enter maintenance quickly.

ops-oncall: I'll be oncall and watching the dashboards + flame graphs. Alerts: deploy-window pager active, adjusted thresholds set. If anything smells off, I'll abort and post reason + metric snapshot.

maya: Final: please react with :thumbsup: if you own the step and are available. Need 4 confirmations to flip the preflight.

sam: :thumbsup:

leo: :thumbsup: (console ready)

anya: :thumbsup: (router ready)

ops-oncall: :thumbsup: (oncall)

deploy-bot: Noted reactions. Preflight will start in 5m. Posting preflight log link once started.

maya: Thanks — I'll flip the switch when preflight passes. Keep this thread for quick rollback notes. :white_check_mark:
